entries.zh:
washer-notify/
├── SKILL.md          ← 唯一必要檔案
└── references/       ← 選用附件（AI 用到才讀）
    └── ha-service-map.md

# SKILL.md 內容
---
name: washer-notify
description: |
  當使用者問「洗衣機洗完了嗎」「該收衣服了嗎」，或提到
  自動化洗衣機提醒時觸發。可透過 HA API 讀取
  sensor.washer_power 判斷是否處於運轉/待機/完成狀態。
license: MIT
compatibility:
  agents: [claude-code, opencode, openclaw, hermes]
  mcp: [ha-mcp-woow, home-assistant/mcp-server]
allowed-tools: [ha_get_state, ha_get_history, notify_send]
---

# 洗衣機提醒 skill

當使用者提到洗衣機時，先讀 sensor.washer_power 過去 15 分鐘的
歷史：如果從 >100W 掉到 <5W 並持續 3 分鐘以上，回覆「洗完了」；
還在運轉則回覆預估剩餘時間（依平均運轉 45 分鐘估算）。

若使用者要求自動提醒，用 ha_config_set_automation 建一條：
trigger: sensor.washer_power < 5W 持續 3 分鐘
action: notify.mobile_app_myphone
先給使用者 YAML 摘要，同意再套用。
entries.en:
washer-notify/
├── SKILL.md ← Only necessary file
└── references/ ← Select attachments (read only when AI is used)
    └── ha-service-map.md

# SKILL.md Contents
---
name: washer-notify
description: |
  When users ask "Is the washing machine finished?" "Is it time to put away the clothes?" or mention
  Triggered when automated washing machine reminds. Can be read via HA API
  sensor.washer_power determines whether it is in running/standby/completion state.
license: MIT
compatibility:
  agents: [claude-code, opencode, openclaw, hermes]
  mcp: [ha-mcp-woow, home-assistant/mcp-server]
allowed-tools: [ha_get_state, ha_get_history, notify_send]
---

# Washing machine reminder skill

When the user mentions a washing machine, first read sensor.washer_power for the past 15 minutes.
History: If it drops from >100W to <5W and lasts for more than 3 minutes, reply "washed";
If it is still running, the estimated remaining time will be returned (estimated based on an average running time of 45 minutes).

If the user requires automatic reminder, use ha_config_set_automation to create one:
trigger: sensor.washer_power < 5W for 3 minutes
action: notify.mobile_app_myphone
Give the user the YAML summary first and agree before applying it.
